worldcombat.skill.beakblast.summary: Heat yourself up first, then fire a shot from the beak like a cannon: after committing, plant and roast the beak; anything that touches the user with its body during that window is burned, and when the window ends the beak shot flies straight out. A longer roast means a heavier shot, paid for by standing exposed. Flying physical, no contact, and stopped by Bulletproof.
The beak shot deals %1$s physical damage; the beak is first heated for %2$s.
During the heat, a foe that touches the user with its body within %1$s blocks is set alight for %2$s.
Range %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks per tick, %3$s block body radius.
worldcombat.skill.beakblast.forge.on: Red-hot form: a longer roast, a heavier and larger shot, at slower projectile speed, -1 block range, +2 preparation and +8 cooldown - the longer the window, the easier it is to be punished by a body pressed in.
worldcombat.skill.beakblast.forge.off: Rapid form: a shorter roast, a faster shot and a shorter cooldown for a safer window, at slightly lower shot power.
worldcombat.skill.beakblast.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.beakblast.growth.0: From level %1$s the shot rises to %2$s and the heated contact radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.beakblast.growth.1: From level %1$s the shot rises to %2$s and the roast to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.beakblast.use.0: Plant, roast the beak, then punch a shot through the target
worldcombat.skill.beakblast.use.1: Punish anyone who presses in with the heated window
worldcombat.skill.beakblast.use.2: Trade a longer roast for a heavier shot
worldcombat.skill.beakblast.preference.f: On: 150% roast, 115% shot power and a larger body, at 92% shot speed, -1 block range, +2 preparation and +8 cooldown. Off (rapid): 70% roast, 108% shot speed and -6 cooldown for a safer window, at 92% shot power.
worldcombat.skill.beakblast.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of firing. Larger values open from farther away.
On: with an enemy already pressed against it, fire first so the heated window punishes them. Off: rank it as an ordinary ranged move.
On: low-health targets rank first, finished by a heavier shot. Off: rank it as an ordinary ranged attack.
